reason: The hunk is indeed only a comment, but Cursor already accepts negative offsets: `self.offset = int(offset)` at src/sentry/utils/cursors.py:28 has no bounds check, and `from_string` (line 59) parses values like "-5", which the new negative-offset slicing in OptimizedCursorPaginator relies on.
